per_h_transfer.where: one H_STORE (stage exit) + one H_LOAD (stage entry) per h transfer: the 40 substage_hop0 nodes + head.hop of the token path; neither has a token-path node

coef_before_norm.where: one COEF job in front of every NORM (serial in the HC master, no token-path node)

coefficient_chain.what: ONE COEF a block reads the pre + post + combine rows, so it waits for the block's own coefficient chain (hc.fn / sumsq -> rsqrt -> pre_post -> sinkhorn) and the NORM waits for it; the priced token path starts hc_pre from the PREVIOUS block's pre_post.  --coef-split = COEF-a (previous block's pre row) before the NORM, COEF-b (this block's post / combine rows) after it: same RTL, same golden

su_classes.source: hierarchical slab dsfd_sp_su_h, full shape, tools/s81_suhc/su_gate.py --hier @b132ae0da (1,722 rows bit-exact in 3,146 cycles); prices = token-path node cycles; hand-off 10-13 07:30 [s81su]
su_classes.note: unit ratios of the slab classes put on the layer: KV (attn.kv_rope_qdq) is off the critical path (0), QB / SW / SO are critical once a layer each; no ledger row is proposed by this stream (the SU owner proposes)

vm_read.measured_unit: dsfd_sp_vm_m master gate tools/s81_vm/s81_vm_gate.py: 8-leaf bgq28 split (branch claude/s81-bgq28-1013 @d415c687f) read latency 41 -> 81 (+40 = 4 tiles x 10), capture / write path + 0; front-end hierarchy dsfd_vm_fe_h (branch claude/el1013-s81-vmfe @693940a56) read latency 41 -> 45 (+4), write landing + 4 / + 7
vm_read.model: streams are pipelined (rate unchanged); an op opens its operand stream only after the producer's rows completed (ARM slot t_rdy), so the first-row latency is serial once per VM-fed op.  The + 160 of the tp case is the MTP P2RD (4 chained reads): head / draft dies, once per MTP wave, not per layer
vm_read.status: MODELLED on the token path from a measured unit delta: tb_s81_die_layer has a behavioural VM (LVM 10), no VM master
vm_read.verdict: > 1 % of a layer except "field phases only at hop 1": hop 2 -> 1, and prefetch of the next op's stream on the producer's row-completion event

collective_split.measured: tb_s81ph_coll_sys dut_last, 277 records / 40 messages, all 4 lane slices split (XLD 3 / PTD 2), claude/s81-cesn-1013 @1c376777a: production FIFOs 3,014 -> 3,021 cycles
collective_split.status: unit bench of the collective against the flat (priced) design; inside 1.10

gather_root.status: UNMEASURED (no RTL): +<= 5 (step A) / +<= 15 (step B) cycles per field phase drain, <= 0.07 % / 0.7 % of a layer

engram.status: dsfd_engram_c ALL-TILE, tools/s81_svceng/engram_c_gate.py; off the token critical path (slack L1 ~8.5k / L14 ~235k cycles): 0 cycles on the priced layer; the L14 layer run hosts eng.* behaviourally

vm_read_measured.what: tb_s81_die_layer, production shape (NG 256, hierarchical HC slab, nominal link, --coef-split), read latency of the behavioural VM raised from the bench default: + 20 = the bgq28 leaf chain at hop 1, + 44 = hop 2 (+ 40) with the front-end hierarchy (+ 4).  Only the HC master reads this VM in the bench (SU / svc / select are behavioural, the field has its own capture path): the field + SU share of the VM read cost stays modelled
vm_read_measured.finding: three VM read round trips of the HC master are serial in a layer: H_LOAD (layer entry) and the COEF-a in front of each of the two NORMs; COEF-b and the boot GAIN loads take the latency too but are off the critical chain
